_meta.purpose: Authoritative parameter registry for DegradationPipeline. All nn.Parameter and constant values declared in src/pipeline.py. No parameter may be omitted.
_meta.handoff_v6_4: HANDOFF_v6.4_sigma_post_ruling.md — sigma_post(S5.5) 신규 도입, 레지스트리 갱신

params.name: N
params.role: Poisson photon count (controls shot noise magnitude)
params.notes: v4+: sigmoid-box [50,1000] so display == pipeline value. Tier 1 frozen in v5.

params.name: sigma_g
params.role: Additive Gaussian background noise standard deviation
params.notes: Tier 1 frozen in v5. Non-identifiable with N (v1-v4 showed 3D ridge with fwhm).

params.name: p
params.role: Salt & Pepper noise density (fraction of corrupted pixels)

params.name: fwhm
params.role: PSF Gaussian blur full width at half maximum
params.notes: Kernel size _psf_k fixed at __init__ from initial fwhm=2.5 [src/pipeline.py:114-121]. v5 result: 1.4248 (DIFFERENT_FROM_MANUAL).

params.name: _psf_k
params.role: PSF convolution kernel size (derived constant, not a Parameter)
params.manual_source: 본 연구 도입 (derived: k = max(3, 2*round(3*sigma)+1) from fwhm_init=2.5 → sigma≈1.062 → k=9)
params.physical: k = int(2*round(3*sigma)+1), max 3, must be odd [src/pipeline.py:118-121]
params.notes: Fixed at __init__ to avoid discrete step in autograd. Recomputed only on new DegradationPipeline() instantiation. k=9 for fwhm_init=2.5.

params.name: alpha
params.role: Vignetting darkening coefficient (fraction at corner vs center)
params.notes: min_brightness=0.50 clamp applied to vignetting map [src/pipeline.py:131,213]. v5 result: 0.4973.

params.name: min_brightness
params.role: Vignetting floor (minimum allowed pixel value after vignetting)
params.physical: vig = clamp(vig, min=min_brightness)  [src/pipeline.py:213]; plain float, not nn.Parameter

params.name: in_low
params.role: Contrast linear rescaling — lower input clip point
params.notes: No bound enforcement in code. Physical sense: in_low < in_high. v5 result: 0.0039 (near 0, not at boundary in absolute sense). in_d_calib=true but v5 value not propagated due to PARAMS_TIER2 omission — flagged in 지시 25.

params.name: in_high
params.role: Contrast linear rescaling — upper input clip point
params.notes: No bound enforcement in code. v5 result: 0.7021. in_d_calib=true but v5 value not propagated due to PARAMS_TIER2 omission — flagged in 지시 25.

params.name: out_low
params.role: Contrast linear rescaling — lower output value
params.notes: HANDOFF v6.2 판정: 캘리브레이션 대상에서 영구 제외. requires_grad=False, frozen=0.1. v5에서 최적화됐으나 비물리적 매핑(out_high>1.0) + 스펙 §1.1 미승인 자유도로 기각. NOT in PARAMS_TIER2 in v5 → not saved to d_calib_config theta_real_mean. v5 did optimize it (optimized value ~0.251, per theta_hat_main). Flagged in 지시 25. Phase 5 비스윕 manual 값: 0.10.

params.name: out_high
params.role: Contrast linear rescaling — upper output value (can exceed 1.0 — clamp applied after)
params.notes: HANDOFF v6.2 판정: 캘리브레이션 대상에서 영구 제외. requires_grad=False, frozen=0.9. v5에서 최적화됐으나 비물리적 매핑(out_high>1.0) + 스펙 §1.1 미승인 자유도로 기각. NOT in PARAMS_TIER2 in v5 → not saved to d_calib_config. v5 found out_high≈1.413 > 1.0 (physically valid — clamp at stage 6 output, not on out_high itself). Flagged in 지시 25. Phase 5 비스윕 manual 값: 0.90.

params.name: sigma_post
params.role: Post-blur detector noise standard deviation (검출기 전자 노이즈 — blur 후단, contrast 전단)
params.manual_source: 본 연구 도입 — ESF/NPS 모순 (HANDOFF v6.4 §0.2); 전작 파이프라인 부재
params.physical: x = x + sigma_post * eps_post  [src/pipeline.py, _stage55_post_noise]; sigma_post=0 → no-op (bit-identical to legacy 7-stage)
params.notes: HANDOFF v6.4 §1.1 신규 도입. vignetting(S5) 후 · contrast(S6) 전 삽입. init=0.01. clamp [1e-4,0.1] in optimizer step. σ_post=0 → bit-identical 검증 완료 (test_pipeline_v5e.py). 민감도: σ_post↔ring 독립 확인 — σ_post dominates L_nps (range 69.5%), ring dominates L_rad (range 72%), ring L_nps 영향 2.3% only.

params.name: ring_strength
params.role: Ring artifact modulation amplitude (fraction of pixel value)
params.notes: v1/v2 consensus ≈0.009 (very different from manual 0.12). v5 result: 0.1012 (11.2× v1/v2 consensus, within 1× of manual). Triggers §O협의. v5b freezes to v1/v2 value 0.009 [지시 24].

params.name: ring_n
params.role: Ring artifact radial frequency (number of ring cycles over radius)
params.notes: v1/v2 consensus ≈8.6. v5 result: 7.987 (close to manual 8.0, consistent with v1/v2). v5b freezes to v1/v2 value 8.6 [지시 24].

params.name: prenorm_a
params.role: Pre-normalization scale: x' = a*x + b (applied to clean templates before pipeline)
params.physical: x' = prenorm_a * x + prenorm_b (external to pipeline.py, applied in calibration scripts)
params.notes: Not in pipeline.py — applied in run_phase4_v*.py before loss computation. Fitted once; frozen v5+. Value from prenorm calibration.

params.name: prenorm_b
params.physical: x' = prenorm_a * x + prenorm_b (external to pipeline.py)
